# Rainbow International School — Best CBSE School in Thane

> Rainbow International School is the leading CBSE-affiliated international school in Thane, Maharashtra, India. Founded in April 2009 and located on a sprawling 3.5-acre campus in Brahmand Phase 4, Thane West, it is widely recognised as one of the best schools in Thane. With CBSE Affiliation Number 1130661, the school serves over 3,000 students from Nursery to Class 12 and has positively impacted more than 1 Lac families. Rainbow International School offers Science, Commerce, and Humanities streams at the senior secondary level, making it a complete K-12 school in Thane for every academic path.

## Academic Sections

### Pre-Primary School in Thane (Nursery to UKG)
Rainbow International School's pre-primary section is among the best nursery schools in Thane. The programme uses play-based and activity-driven learning for early childhood development. Children aged 2.5 to 5.5 years build foundational skills through sensory play, storytelling, music, and structured exploration in a safe, nurturing environment.

### Primary School in Thane (Class 1 to 5)
The primary section builds strong academic foundations through experiential and project-based learning. Students develop literacy, numeracy, scientific curiosity, and social skills through the CBSE curriculum enhanced with international pedagogy. The school is recognised as one of the top primary schools in Thane.

### Middle School in Thane (Class 6 to 8)
The middle school section at Rainbow International School focuses on subject specialisation, critical thinking, and analytical reasoning. Students are prepared for higher academic challenges through a balanced mix of academics, co-curricular activities, and leadership opportunities. It is a trusted middle school in Thane for holistic development.

### Secondary School in Thane (Class 9 to 10)
The secondary section provides rigorous CBSE board preparation alongside holistic education. Students receive focused coaching for Board examinations while continuing to develop through sports, arts, and life skills. Rainbow International School is a top-rated secondary school in Thane with consistently strong board results.

### Senior Secondary School in Thane (Class 11 to 12)
The senior secondary section offers Science, Commerce, and Humanities streams — making it one of the few schools in Thane offering all three. With experienced faculty, career counselling, and competitive exam preparation, it is the preferred senior secondary school in Thane for students aiming for engineering, medicine, business, law, and the liberal arts.

## Rainbow Preschool International — Best Preschool in Thane

Rainbow Preschool International is the early childhood wing of Rainbow International School, serving children aged 1.5 to 5.5 years. Programmes include Playgroup, Nursery, Junior KG, and Senior KG. With 100% trained female staff and 6 centres across Thane, it is trusted by thousands of families as the best preschool in Thane. The curriculum follows a play-based, activity-driven approach aligned with NEP 2020 guidelines for foundational learning.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Which is the best CBSE school in Thane?**
Rainbow International School is widely recognised as the best CBSE school in Thane. With CBSE Affiliation Number 1130661, a 3.5-acre campus, award-winning teaching, and over 3,000 students, it consistently ranks among the top schools in Thane across independent surveys and parent reviews.

**Is Rainbow International School affiliated to CBSE?**
Yes. Rainbow International School is affiliated to the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) with Affiliation Number 1130661 and School Code 30562. It follows the CBSE curriculum from Nursery to Class 12.

**Does Rainbow International School offer Science, Commerce, and Humanities?**
Yes. The senior secondary section (Class 11-12) offers all three streams — Science, Commerce, and Humanities. It is one of the few schools in Thane that offers all three streams under one roof, giving students the flexibility to choose their path.

**What classes does Rainbow International School offer?**
Rainbow International School is a K-12 school in Thane offering classes from Nursery to Class 12. This includes Pre-Primary (Nursery, Jr KG, Sr KG), Primary (Class 1-5), Middle School (Class 6-8), Secondary (Class 9-10), and Senior Secondary (Class 11-12).

**Where is Rainbow International School located in Thane?**
The school is located at Cosmos Arcade, Brahmand Phase 4, Thane West, Maharashtra 400607. It is easily accessible from Ghodbunder Road, Manpada, Hiranandani Estate, Patlipada, Kolshet, and Majiwada. A school bus service covers major areas across Thane.

**How can I apply for school admission in Thane?**
Parents can apply for admission at Rainbow International School by visiting the school campus, calling +91 82915 68972, or filling out the online enquiry form at https://rainbowinternationalschool.in/contact-us. Admissions are open for the 2026-27 academic year for Nursery to Class 12.

**What makes Rainbow International School different from other schools in Thane?**
Rainbow International School combines CBSE academic rigour with international pedagogy, Multiple Intelligence-based teaching, a 3.5-acre campus with dedicated sports facilities, smart classrooms, award-winning preschool wing, all three senior secondary streams, and a strong focus on safety and holistic development. It has been recognised by the British Council, NABET, and multiple national awards.
